import pytest
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from requests.models import Request

def test_preserve_leading_slashes():
    adapter = HTTPAdapter()
    # Prepare a request with leading slashes in path
    url = "https://bucket.s3.amazonaws.com//key_with_leading_slash.txt"
    req = Request('GET', url)
    prep = req.prepare()
    
    # request_url is called with (request, proxies)
    # We assume proxies is None for this test
    actual_url = adapter.request_url(prep, proxies=None)
    
    # prep.path_url for this URL should be //key_with_leading_slash.txt
    # The current (buggy) implementation should collapse it to /key_with_leading_slash.txt
    assert actual_url == "//key_with_leading_slash.txt"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pytest.main([__file__])
